items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: And as it was, I had made… I came to the States in ’47 with my uncle, and I met Hank Jones and those guys at 52nd Street. That was the Three Deuces. And every week there was an all-star group but with the same guys. One week was J.J. Johnson, the leader. One week was Howard McGee, a fine trumpet player. And we went there. Now it’s getting long. I have to talk about maybe, I was in Miami with my uncle for his vacation. I went with him to Miami.
